§cTHIS IS NOT OPTIONAL DEPTH - STEP 8 NEEDS IT§r
The interlock refuses every cycle the chamber cannot cool, so an unfed §9COOL§r hatch parks the plant at §2RPM 0§r and§2 0 EU/t§r no matter how good the rest of it is. That is why this quest opens at step 7, one step before the clock.

§1Plain water IS a rung§r, and it is the one step 8 starts you on: at the few hundred RPM a first cycle reaches, the chamber wants tens of litres a tick, not thousands. The ladder below is what you climb as the fan speeds up.

§cRPM SQUARED IS HEAT§r
  §9load  = 200 x (RPM/1000)^2 + swirl^2 x 5/20§r   per tick
  §9drain = ceil(load / Q)§r   litres per tick

  Water                        §8Q 1.0§r    §c 28,800 L/t at the redline§r
  Distilled Water              §8Q 1.5§r     19,200 L/t
  IC2 Coolant                  §8Q 4.0§r      7,200 L/t
  Super Coolant                §8Q 12.0§r     2,400 L/t
  Liquid Cryotheum             §8Q 40.0§r       720 L/t
  §2Tachyon Rich Temporal Fluid  Q 160.0       180 L/t§r

§8The top rung is the MOLTEN form - NEI lists it as "Molten Tachyon Rich Temporal Fluid". The panel prints the short name.§r

Halve the RPM and the bill drops to a QUARTER. That is the entire trade.

§5MAKING IT IN BULK§r §8- beside the stock recipes, never instead of them.§r
Two of those rungs get an§9 8x batch route§r that runs in §1half the time eight stock cycles would take§r. Neither stock recipe was touched, so nothing you have already automated changes.
  §9Shim§r §8LCR, HV, 20 s§r  §2 2x Lithium Dust + 2,000 L Boric Acid + 1,000 L Water + circuit 1  ->  2,000 L Chemical Shim§r
     §8A real PWR chemical shim: soluble borate poison, with lithium hydroxide holding the pH up so it does not eat the loop. It is a REAGENT - it is never fed to the chamber, and it is not a seventh rung of the ladder above.§r
  §9IC2 Coolant batch§r §8Chemical Plant t2, EV, 1,024 ticks§r  §2 8x Lapis Dust + 8,000 L Distilled Water + 200 L Shim + circuit 11  ->  8,000 L IC2 Coolant§r
  §9Super Coolant batch§r §8Vacuum Freezer, IV, 800 ticks§r  §2 8,000 L Hot Super Coolant + 400 L Shim  ->  8,000 L Super Coolant§r
§88,000 L is exactly one plain Input Hatch, which is why the batch is 8x and not 10x. One shim run (2,000 L) doses 80,000 L of IC2 Coolant batches or 40,000 L of Super Coolant batches, so the shim is a light tax rather than the thing that gates you.§r

§5§lDO §lTHIS§r
Feed the Spiral chamber's §9COOL§r Input Hatch - front wall, one course above the floor, beside the propellant hatch - and scale the loop every single time you climb the propellant ladder. The plant does not forgive a cooling loop designed for last month's speed.

§8This hatch is the chamber's alone. The reactor's feedwater comes from a different hatch on a different building, and neither can drink the other's fluid - which is why a water-grade coolant loop can never be siphoned off by the boiler.§r

§5§lTHE §lINTERLOCK§r
A cycle is only ACCEPTED while a simulated drain says the chamber can cool the RPM that cycle would reach, and the injectors are not dry. If it cannot, the RPM is simply HELD and the panel prints the reason - no steam drunk, no propellant burned, no heat added. §2An unplumbed plant never spins up rather than blowing up.§r

§2§lDONE §lWHEN§r
§916 Empty Cells§r are in your inventory - the container the middle of this ladder travels in. §8Nothing is taken; the quest only looks. You do not need one to START: step 8 puts plain WATER in that hatch, and water is a real rung of this ladder.§r

§5§lCHECK §lYOUR §lWORK§r
The STEAM CHAIN group's coolant line names your fluid and a live drain figure. While it reads §cCoolant NOT SUPPLIED§r the interlock is refusing cycles; while it reads §cCoolant STARVED§r the hatch holds nothing on the ladder at all.

[warn]Losing coolant AT SPEED trips a protective spin-down (RPM x0.95/t) instead of a seizure - the panel says §cCOOLANT LOST§r - but friction heat still accrues, so a chamber already near SCRAM can still tear the spine's rotor housings apart.[/warn]
